t: Durango Men’s Maverick XP Composite Toe Waterproof Work Boot (DDB0480)
d:
Details 
 Step into high performance work in the men’s 11” Composite Toe Waterproof Burly Brown/Black Durango® Maverick XP™.
 This style features 900-denier nylon with a padded collar, leather instep for added comfort, a Durango® waterproof membrane bootie construction to keep your feet dry, an abrasion resistant TPU toe cap and heel counter. Inside the boot is a soft mesh lining, Durango® X-treme Comfort Footbed™, Fiberglass shank and Dual-Density EVA midsole.
 The outsole has a rolled shank area with anti-torsion rigid external shank and a slip, oil and heat resisting multi-durometer rubber outsole. The style is finished off with a storm welt, single row sole stitch, 1 ½” rocker heel, square toe, and ASTM F2413 protective toe and electrical hazard standard classification.
 This boot is designed to face whatever your daily grind demands. Get a pair today!
- Rolled shank area
- Anti-torsion rigid external shank provides added lateral stability
- Dual-density EVA midsole
- Abrasion resistant TPU toe cap and heel counter
- 1 1/2" Rocker heel
